All transamidase complex subunits., e.g.

PomBase	SPAC1002.11	gaa1	involved_in	GO:0006506	GO_REF:0000041	IEA	UniPathway:UPA00196	P	GPI-anchor transamidase complex subunit Gaa1		protein	taxon:4896	20240129	UniProt

PomBase	SPAC1F12.09	gpi17	involved_in	GO:0006506	GO_REF:0000041	IEA	UniPathway:UPA00196	P	pig-S		protein	taxon:4896	20240129	UniProt		
PomBase	SPBC1604.15	gpi16	involved_in	GO:0006506	GO_REF:0000041	IEA	UniPathway:UPA00196	P	pig-T, Gpi16		protein	taxon:4896	20240129	UniProt	



**Description of issue**

These are part of the attachment of the GPI to the protein and not part of GPI biosynthesis per se.

and should move to GO:0016255 attachment of GPI anchor to protein
